summary: Rape conviction upheld; sole testimony of prosecutrix sufficient; no injury to private parts not fatal; medical evidence inconclusive but not discrediting; delay in FIR explained; false implication claim baseless; threat to prosecutrix acknowledged; character of prosecutrix's mother irrelevant; conviction under Sections 376, 323 IPC affirmed; remission to be considered per state policy.
legal_provisions_cited: State of Punjab v. Gurmit Singh
Bharwada Bhoginbhai Hirjibhai v. State of Gujarat
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment affirming conviction and sentence upheld; direction for remission consideration within four weeks issued.
